extracted.intended_audience: Wikipedia contributors / editors attempting to create or find an article
extracted.subtask_description: Explains why a requested Wikipedia page may not exist and gives steps and requirements for finding, creating, or requesting a new article. Covers account/confirmation requirements, searching for existing titles, redirects, and deletion checks.

rubrics_metrics.name: Account and autoconfirmed requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: You need to log in or create an account and be autoconfirmed to create new articles.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: To create an article you must have a Wikipedia account and meet the 'autoconfirmed' status (this is a prerequisite to creating new pages). If you do not meet these requirements, you cannot directly create the page.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use the article wizard or request a new article
rubrics_metrics.description: Alternatively, you can use the article wizard to submit a draft for review, or request a new article.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If you cannot or should not create the live article immediately (e.g., lacking autoconfirmed status or needing review), use the article wizard to prepare and submit a draft, or file a request for a new article so experienced editors can assist or review it.

rubrics_metrics.name: Search existing articles for alternative titles or spellings
rubrics_metrics.description: Please search for 'Beverly Hills Cop Axel Foley' in existing articles. Check for alternative titles or spellings.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Before creating a new page, perform searches to ensure the topic isn't already covered under a different title or spelling. This avoids duplicate articles and helps find correct canonical titles.

rubrics_metrics.name: Check pages that link to the title (look for backlinks)
rubrics_metrics.description: Look for pages within Wikipedia that link to this title.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examine pages that link to the desired title to discover mentions, redirects, or related coverage that might clarify whether an article exists under a different name or deserves creation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Recently created pages may not be visible immediately
rubrics_metrics.description: If a page was recently created here, it may not be visible yet because of a delay in updating the database; wait a few minutes or try the purge function.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If you expect a page to exist but cannot see it, wait briefly for database propagation or use the page purge function to refresh cached results before creating another page with the same title.

rubrics_metrics.name: Title case-sensitivity and use of redirects
rubrics_metrics.description: Titles on Wikipedia are case sensitive except for the first character; please check alternative capitalizations and consider adding a redirect here to the correct title.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Verify capitalisation variants of the title and, if appropriate, create or request redirects from alternate capitalizations or spellings so readers find the correct article.

rubrics_metrics.name: If the page was deleted, check the deletion log and reasons
rubrics_metrics.description: If the page has been deleted, check the deletion log, and see Why was the page I created deleted?
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If an attempted page creation resulted in deletion, consult the deletion log to learn the deletion rationale and follow guidance on addressing issues (notability, sourcing, format) before attempting recreation or appeal.
